tasks.request: Add optional priority (integer 0..9, default 0) to Job and QueueService.submit. API submit accepts optional priority, returning priority only when supplied, preserving the old response shape otherwise. Reject bool, non-integer and out-of-range values before writing.

Change QueueService.submit(key, payload, ...) to accept keyword-only metadata=None. Store an independent copy per Job; expose a copy in API only when metadata is supplied. Update all in-repository callers and tests. Predict affected pre-existing entities before editing.
Harden priority/metadata validation: mutated caller dictionaries must not change stored jobs, and a rejected submission must not reserve its key. Preserve prior behavior; add regressions.

Introduce a JobRepository Protocol port and make QueueService depend on it instead of concrete storage internals. Preserve all public behavior; service must not access _jobs or import the concrete store module.

Add cancel(key) returning True once and False on repeated cancellation; missing key also returns False. Cancelled jobs remain queryable with state cancelled. Expose cancellation through API without changing submission semantics.

Add a second in-memory repository implementation with copy-on-read semantics. Run the same public behavior tests against both adapters, keep domain independent of service/api/store, and update the architecture rationale.

Add an optional memo string to LedgerService.transfer and expose it through API; successful transfer returns a receipt with source, target, amount, memo. Preserve existing call forms; no balance changes on invalid input.
Make transfer amount keyword-only. Update API and all callers/tests while preserving receipt semantics. Predict affected pre-existing entities before editing.
Reject self-transfer and bool/non-integer amounts. Missing accounts and insufficient funds must leave all balances unchanged; add regression tests.
Introduce an AccountRepository Protocol port without importing concrete storage from LedgerService. Preserve public contracts and prohibit direct access to _accounts.

Add optional idempotency_key: repeating the exact transfer returns the original receipt without a second debit; the same key with different arguments raises ValueError. Rejected transfers do not reserve keys.
Provide a second in-memory repository adapter using copy-on-read and explicit balance updates. Run the same transfer contract tests on both; keep account domain independent of application adapters.

Add optional labels list to publish and Artifact. Copy labels to immutable per-artifact state; API accepts and returns labels only when explicitly supplied. Preserve old API response and reject non-string label members before storing.

Make version keyword-only in ArtifactService.publish and add metadata=None as keyword-only. Update all callers/API/tests and isolate metadata from caller mutation. Predict affected pre-existing entities before editing.
Validate version as a positive integer excluding bool; reject empty or whitespace-only names. Failed validation must not occupy an artifact key. Add boundary/regression tests.
Introduce ArtifactRepository Protocol and depend on it from service; service must not read _items or import the concrete store. Preserve all visible behavior.
Add latest(name), selecting the highest numeric version without lexicographic sorting. Missing name raises KeyError. Expose the lookup in API and include regression tests for versions 2 and 10.
Add a second in-memory adapter that copies values on read. Test both adapters against the same public contracts; domain cannot import service/api/store; document the adapter boundary.
Add optional owner string to Booking and BookingService.book. API accepts owner and returns it only when supplied, preserving its original response otherwise. Owner must be non-empty when supplied.

Make book start and end keyword-only, with metadata=None also keyword-only. Update API and all callers/tests; isolate stored metadata from caller mutation. Predict affected pre-existing entities before editing.

Reject bool and non-integer endpoints; reject empty resource names. Preserve half-open intervals so adjacent bookings succeed. All rejected bookings leave the store unchanged; add boundary regressions.
Introduce BookingRepository Protocol used by service without importing concrete store or reading _bookings. Preserve overlap semantics and API contracts.

Add cancellation by generated booking ID. Cancel returns True on first cancellation and False for repeated or missing IDs. Cancelled intervals release capacity; API supports the ID without breaking existing book responses unless explicitly requested.
Add a second in-memory adapter with copy-on-read semantics. Run common booking/cancel tests on both adapters. Keep domain independent of service/api/store and document the boundary.
